Claim: objectui#9370 — move the three published `skills/objectui` guides off the retired `data` root and the retired `bind` resolution
Clause-②: yes

**Claimed by the `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`) — dispatched to an `os-dev` seat this round.**

## Routing: option C, as the filing seat recommended

The objectui#9308 seat hit two instructions pointing opposite ways — "fix what this round makes false" against "⛔ do not touch `skills/**`" — and took **A**: it filed this card with a per-line census rather than folding the three files into PR objectui#9369. ⭐ Correct, and the reason is concrete: folding three governed files in would have parked **the PR that clears a red on `main`** behind a human merge.

Its recommended follow-up was **C** — hand this to the governed skills lane rather than opening a second front. Taken: dispatched as its own PR, which costs **one** human review instead of two.

## Premise — inherited from a per-line census, and the seat re-verifies it

`skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md` lines **112, 113, 302-303, 305, 393**; plus `guides/data-integration.md` and `rules/protocol.md` carrying the same `bind` teaching. ⚠️ Line numbers were measured on the objectui#9308 branch, not on `main` — the seat re-measures against whatever `origin/main` carries when it branches, and the re-measurement wins.

## ⭐ The part that is not a renaming, and must reach the reader

The ruling changes **behaviour**, and a reader who only sees new API names will mis-migrate:

| scope | `data.status == 'draft'` |
|---|---|
| `{ data: undefined }` | `false` |
| no `data` key at all | `true` (unevaluable, fail-soft) |

⇒ a `data.*` gate authored from these guides used to **hide** its node on every row and now **shows** it on every row. The correct runtime-layer row root is `record` (ADR-0089 D3). ⛔ A migration note that only swaps provider names is incomplete.

## Clause-② is `yes`

Published `skills/**` making falsifiable contract-semantics claims about which roots a tier binds — the same limb that put objectui#9311 through this review. ⛔ The governed-surface human merge does **not** substitute for it; the two stack (`references/contract-review.md`: 「受管面人工合并 ⛔ 不替代复核,两道保障叠加」).

⚠️ The resulting PR parks as **draft** needing an APPROVED review from an authorized approver (`os-zhuang`, `hotlong`). That is the designed end state. The precedent from this same round is objectui#9352, which was approved and merged as `28be0786d`.

## What was broken, and what this comment changes

`check-clause2-carriers --pair 9378` read the pair as **UNJUDGED** for two days: comment `5652138683` matches the claim marker, but its `Branch:` directive parses to **zero** branches — the branch is named nowhere on a line of its own. An unparsed claim is an UNCLASSIFIED result, ⛔ never an absent declaration and ⛔ never a declared `no`.

⇒ This comment adds **only** the missing `Branch:` line, on a line of its own, so the declaration that was already made becomes resolvable.

- ⛔ **The declaration is not mine and is not re-judged.** `Clause-②: yes` above is carried over verbatim from `5652138683`, where the `os-tesla` claim states its own reasoning (published `skills/**` making falsifiable contract-semantics claims about which roots a tier binds — the limb that put objectui#9311 through the same review). I am restating it, ⛔ not deciding it.
- The `Claim:` first line is present because the checker reads **the card's NEWEST claim comment**; a bare `Branch:` comment would not be read at all and the pair would have stayed UNJUDGED.
- ⛔ Nothing about this card's state, assignee, PR or review posture changes. `needs:contract-review` stays hung on PR objectui#9378 — no review record of any kind exists yet, and per the standing contract the carrier hangs exactly while that is true.

## The branch, measured rather than recalled

| reading | value |
|:--|:--|
| `git ls-remote --heads origin refs/heads/claude/issue-9370-skills-data-root` | `5df0ee9719178037689ca3fb7c61394eab88ec2d` |
| PR objectui#9378 `head.ref` / `head.sha` | `claude/issue-9370-skills-data-root` / `5df0ee9719178037689ca3fb7c61394eab88ec2d` |
| lit control — `refs/heads/main` | `4a94c38b0bb71a98f2c85c7aee456f6a34432e47` (instrument fires) |

The branch sha and the PR head sha are byte-identical, so the branch this line names is the one that PR delivers.

## ⚠️ Not a seat-template fault — measured, because #9570 asked

#9570 carries the checker's warning that 「a whole shift of claims reading this way is a SEAT TEMPLATE fault, not a typo」. Measured against the whole board this fire (`check-clause2-carriers`, no `--pair`, 5 pairs from 8 open PRs): this is the **only** UNJUDGED pair. The template in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈模板与表〉 already carries `Branch:` on its own line and is ⛔ not at fault — this was one claim composed away from the template, not a template defect. ⇒ ⛔ no template change is owed.

⚠️ The same board reading did surface **two** separate pairs with **no claim comment at all** — objectui#9466 / #9213 and objectui#9391 / #9317. Both cards are **`domain:devx`**, ⛔ not this lane, and the checker is explicit that the declaration IS the judgement and ⛔ must not be filled in on the claiming seat's behalf. Recorded for the director seat's 职责一 audit; ⛔ not acted on here.

Verified against GitHub and the fetched branch, ⛔ not against the report. Tier H (`skills/**`) ⇒ the terminal's four pieces in this act: ① this ACCEPT + the `## Contract review` record on the PR (PASS); ② the card moves `pm:dispatched` → `needs-user-decision` with the 终稿速读 below (no assignee is set — none was, and this seat writes no `Claim:` here: the claim of record stays 5652138683 / 5689310818, see objectstack#19240); ③ review requested from `os-zhuang` and `hotlong` on the draft PR; ④ the round report lists it under awaiting a human merge.

- **PR shape**: draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #9370`, the clause spelled as a heading in the body (the card's claim carries the line-start `Clause-②: yes`; the reader judges the card), session footer, no model identifier in the body or the two commits; `needs:contract-review` on both carriers (`--pair 9378` exit 0). No changeset owed (`check-changeset-presence` exit 0 at the head).
- **Scope = the card's census and the dispatch claim (5652138683)**: exactly the three files — `guides/data-integration.md` +40 / −12, `guides/schema-expressions.md` +76 / −10, `rules/protocol.md` +18 / −5; no other guide, no package source, no eval JSON (`check-skill-eval-tokens` exit 0).
- **Done-when (the card's 「What is now false」 table) met**: :112–:113 scope table, :302–:305 `bind` teaching, :393 comment, and the same `bind` teaching in the other two files now name ONE channel — `PredicateScopeProvider` (`@object-ui/react`), every `scope` key a root, `bind` reading the same bag — plus what `dataSource` still is (the adapter), the renderer's own `record` / `page`, and a per-layer statement of the verdict flip with `record` as the runtime-layer root (ADR-0089 D3).
- **Seat's own reads on objectui `origin/main`**: `SchemaRendererContext.tsx` :113–:114; `SchemaRenderer.tsx` :866 / :940–:953 / :969–:974; `useExpression.ts` :36 / :50 with the export chain `hooks/index.ts` :9 → `index.ts` :11; `list.tsx` :11 / :17; `CANONICAL_ROOT_BY_LAYER` in objectstack `packages/lint/src/validate-visibility-predicates.ts` :894–:897 — the dev's channel decision is a reading of that code; objectui#9308 is merged (PR #9369, `85243729`), so the 「merge after #9369」 condition in the PR body is met.
- **Base drift**: 347 commits behind; `origin/main` touched only `rules/protocol.md` since the merge base (`efc1c9c4`, :107–:115), disjoint from this PR's hunks; open PR #9592's hunk on the same file (:238–:262) is disjoint too; `git merge-tree` clean, REST `mergeable: true`.

- **Gates**: run at the head in a read-only worktree — `check-skills-paths` 0 · `check-skill-eval-tokens` 0 · `check-changeset-presence` 0. ⚠️ **CI never ran on this head**: 0 check-runs; the 22 workflow runs of 2026-09-13T08:45Z were `startup_failure` / stuck `queued` (runner-side). The seat's `update-branch` call was refused by this session's classifier, so a fresh PR-level run needs one human click (「Update branch」) or the queue's own build at merge time. `check-skill-examples` and the two guide-reading pins are NOT MEASURED here (the dev's readings at the branch: 16 / 16 marked fences pass).
- **Landing** = after an authorized APPROVED review (`GOVERNED_APPROVERS`): this seat, as the lane's landing seat under ruling C (objectstack#17971), runs the three pre-landing checks, clears `needs:contract-review` on both carriers, ready through `.../ccr/ready_for_review`, auto-merge through `.../ccr/auto_merge`; residue at MERGED (`pm:*` off).

## 维护者速读(终稿)

**改了什么** — 三个已发布的 skills 文件:`guides/data-integration.md`(+40/−12)、`guides/schema-expressions.md`(+76/−10)、`rules/protocol.md`(+18/−5)。旧文教读者把数据塞进 `SchemaRendererProvider` 的 `dataSource`,再用 `${data.…}` 和 `bind` 去读;新文只点名一条能用的通道:宿主用 `PredicateScopeProvider` 发布 `scope`,它的每个键都是表达式的根,`bind` 读同一组;`dataSource` 只是取数适配器,不发布任何根。schema-expressions.md 新增一段按层写的「判定翻转」提示:老页面上写的 `${data.status == 'draft'}` 门,过去逢行必隐、现在逢行必显(谓词层失败软化为 `true`),而 `content` 里的同一串会把模板原文打到屏幕上;正确的行级根是 `record`(ADR-0089 D3)。页面原有的 `${data.*}` 示例保留,但新的接线示例明确发布了一个名为 `data` 的键,并在表里写明每个示例都以此为前提。

**为什么改** — objectui#9308(PR #9369,09-13 已合并)之后渲染器不再把适配器发布为 `data` 根、`useDataScope` 也不再走适配器;这三页照旧文接线的读者页面不报错但结果全错。是 auth-permissions.md(PR #9669)与 page-builder.md(PR #9997)同一类问题的三个成员。席位在 objectui main 上复核了 `useDataScope` → `usePredicateScope`、渲染器求值器的根集合(`SchemaRenderer.tsx` :969–:974)与 `PredicateScopeProvider` 的导出链,dev 的通道判断与代码一致;`record`/`data` 分层与 `CANONICAL_ROOT_BY_LAYER` 常量一致。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 纯文档改动,不动包源码、不发版、不欠 changeset(门禁 exit 0)。与 main 的后续改动(protocol.md :107–:115)和在途 PR #9592(protocol.md :238–:262)都不相交,`merge-tree` 干净。⚠️ 一处缺口:该 head 上 CI 从未跑成(09-13 当天 22 个 workflow 全部 `startup_failure` 或卡在 `queued`,是 runner 侧故障),席位想用 update-branch 让它重跑,被本会话分类器拒绝;本地能跑的三条门禁(skills-paths、skill-eval-tokens、changeset-presence)全绿,需要构建产物的 `check-skill-examples` 与两条读文档的测试 pin 只有 dev 当时的读数(16/16 通过)。合并队列会在合并结果上重新构建测试;如想先看 PR 级门禁,批准前在 PR 页面点一次「Update branch」即可,内容记录不受影响。回滚 = revert 两个 commit。

**席位意见** — 建议批准。三处文件的每一句都有代码读数支撑,示例在新前提下为真,合并干净;唯一保留是 CI 未在此 head 跑过,已写明成因与两种补法。

**你要做的** — 在 PR objectstack-ai/objectui#9378 上以授权账号提交一条 APPROVED review(已向 os-zhuang / hotlong 请审;可先点「Update branch」看门禁);其余由席位落地。
